ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white geometric blobs are located on the lateral-medial portions of the left and right lobes. These are bisected by a low-intensity black central band extending from the peduncle to the notch. Fine-grained, low-intensity dendritic patterns extend from the trailing edge boundary into the white patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 64 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the fluke's total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge; peaks and valleys range from 2-10 pixels in amplitude, with the highest concentration of acute serrations located on the distal 30% of each lobe's edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex curve sweep for both trailing edges, with localized concavity observed near the transition to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (rosette-like) are symmetrically distributed: one in the lower-mid quadrant of the left white patch and one in the lower-mid quadrant of the right white patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically aligned low-intensity pixel strings detected within the right lobe's high-intensity white field, indicative of linear surface disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark linear mark or indentation is visible on the interior margin of the right lobe, adjacent to the central black pigmentation band.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled/branching pixel transition zone between the black trailing edge and the white interior patches, characterized by irregular high-contrast 'fringing'.
